name: Gater
description: Glitch²-style trance Gate for NTS-3. Chops live AUDIO IN on a tempo grid while the pad is held (no freeze). Y = gate rate (bottom slow, top fast). Depth = wet. Untouched = bypass. DECAY smooths edges. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to engage. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
